motifs.name: monumental_left_pine
motifs.description: Isolate the large old pine dominating the left side: thick twisting trunk, exposed knots, branching limbs, and dense rounded clusters of pine needles extending across the upper-left and middle of the scene. Exclude the pavilion roof, rocks, and nearby shrubs except where pine trunk or needles are visibly part of the tree.
must_preserve: gnarled bark contours and knotted trunk texture
dark ink outlines around twisting branches
radiating pine-needle clusters with blue-gray wash accents
irregular branch rhythm and overhanging horizontal limb

motifs.name: open_hillside_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the small open pavilion set into the hillside beneath the pine, including its sloped tiled roof, open posts, lattice walls, porch, seated scholar and attendant-like interior figures, and the immediate architectural platform. Exclude surrounding large pine trunk, rocks, and distant shrubs unless structurally attached to the pavilion.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry and layered eaves
parallel roof tile lines
thin post-and-lattice linework
small interior scholar figures and red color accents
delicate ink outlines of platform and steps

must_preserve: thin railing and post geometry

must_preserve: long parallel curving water lines
soft blank-paper water reserve
